# Certilogo Discover

> > Certilogo's resource hub for connected products, Digital Product Passports, and product authentication solutions in fashion and luxury goods.

Certilogo provides connected product technology using QR, NFC, and RFID for brand protection, authentication, and Digital Product Passport implementation. The platform serves fashion and luxury brands with solutions for consumer engagement, circular economy, and supply chain traceability.

## Key Topics

- Digital Product Passports
- Product Authentication
- Connected Products
- Brand Protection
- NFC Technology
- Consumer Engagement
- Circular Economy
- Fashion Technology
- Supply Chain Traceability
- Blockchain
- Secure by Design
- Michele Casucci
- Sustainability
- Grey Market Prevention
- Digital Product ID

## Core Solutions

- [Smart Connected Products](https://discover.certilogo.com/pages/smart-connected-products): Connected products using QR, NFC, RFID for authentication and traceability
- [12 things you need to know before you connect your products](https://discover.certilogo.com/blogs/insights-blog/12-things-you-need-to-know-before-you-connect-your-products): Essential guide to product authentication and Digital Product IDs/Passports
- [Case Off-White Watches](https://discover.certilogo.com/pages/case-off-white-watches): Off-White implements secure Digital Warranty for limited edition watches
- [How to initiate a connected product project with Certilogo | FAQ](https://discover.certilogo.com/pages/faq-for-brands-what-do-i-need-to-do-to-initiate-a-connected-product-project-with-certilogo-from-an-operational-point-of-view): FAQ: Operational steps to initiate connected product projects with Certilogo
